name: Reveal
purpose: Peel the matching silicone mould and present the exact creation.
on_enter: Require filledBodyRevision==bodyRevision and fillProgress=1; otherwise route safely to 07.
Build hero from canonical recipe and seed, then position inside correct mould.
If revealComplete for this revision, render final pose without replaying forced motion.
on_exit: Resolve to durable revealed/unrevealed marker; stop peel sounds.
persistence: revealComplete=true and revealedBodyRevision=bodyRevision after final logical state; no reward at reveal.
back_rule: Back 07 retains completed fill. Next 09 with draft context. Home retains draft and safe reveal state.
acceptance: Every mould clears its toy with no clipping.
Skip and uninterrupted reveal reach identical data and visible final pose.
Colours, material, faces and inclusions never swap to stock imagery.
implementation_notes: One shape-specific peel clip/rig per mould. Bind generic event names, not generic cube geometry.
The hand glyph becomes Next after reveal; Skip appears only while a reveal is active.

actions.trigger: Tap peel tab, mould or toy
actions.command: Start 1.5s peel: tab 0–0.2s, near wall .2–.7, walls .7–1.1, land 1.1–1.5; enter ready
actions.feedback: Pip smiles; optional gentle peel/landing sounds.
actions.interrupt: Pointerup does not stop tap-start reveal; global pause freezes; reload unfinished reveal restores closed with valid fill.

actions.interrupt: No automatic save, gift or coins.
